defects.description: Story/contract: e-mail uniqueness is case-insensitive; registering an address differing only in letter case must be refused with responseCode 400 'Email already exists!'. The AUT creates a second account (responseCode 201 'User created!') for the upper-cased address.
defects.evidence: createAccount email=qa-author-<ts>@example.com -> {"responseCode": 201, "message": "User created!"}; then createAccount email=QA-AUTHOR-<ts>@EXAMPLE.COM (all other fields valid) -> {"responseCode": 201, "message": "User created!"} (HTTP 200); getUserDetailByEmail for the upper-case address -> 200 with a different user id. Reproduced twice (ts 1790469669 and 1790469986). Same-spelling duplicate correctly gives 400 'Email already exists!'. Note also that verifyLogin/getUserDetailByEmail treat e-mail case-sensitively (upper-case lookup of a lower-case account -> 404).

defects.description: Story/contract: createAccount with an e-mail that is not a valid address (e.g. no '@') is refused with responseCode 400 and no account is created. The AUT accepts it: responseCode 201 'User created!' and the account exists.
defects.evidence: createAccount email=qa-author-notanemail-<ts> (no @), all other required fields valid -> {"responseCode": 201, "message": "User created!"}; again with email=qa-author-v2-<ts>.example.com -> 201; getUserDetailByEmail for that address -> responseCode 200 with the user. Reproduced twice; accounts deleted afterwards via deleteAccount (works with the invalid address).

defects.description: Contract §2.3 lists mobile_number among the user fields returned by getUserDetailByEmail (AC-7: every listed field, holding the registration values). The AUT's user object has no mobile_number (all other listed fields are present, with values matching registration).
defects.evidence: createAccount ... mobile_number=9999999999 -> 201; GET /api/getUserDetailByEmail?email=... -> {"responseCode": 200, "user": {"id": 2936749, "name": "QA Author", "email": ..., "title": "Mr", "birth_day": "10", "birth_month": "May", "birth_year": "1990", "first_name": "Qa", "last_name": "Author", "company": "QACo", "address1": "1 Test St", "address2": "Suite 2", "country": "India", "state": "Karnataka", "city": "Bengaluru", "zipcode": "560001"}} — no mobile_number, no password. Reproduced twice (second account mobile_number=5145550100).

traps: Envelope: every listed call answers HTTP 200; the codes in the story/contract are the body's responseCode (stated explicitly in contract §1.1). Asserting HTTP 201/400/404/405 is a script defect, not an AUT defect. Content-Type is text/html although the body is JSON.

Parameters must be form-encoded in the request body, including for DELETE /deleteAccount and PUT /updateAccount. Sending DELETE params in the query string gives responseCode 400 'Bad request, email parameter is missing in DELETE request.'; sending JSON gives 'parameter is missing' answers. Reporting those as AUT failures is wrong.

Response field names differ from request names (birth_date -> birth_day, firstname -> first_name, lastname -> last_name); the contract lists the response names. Only mobile_number is actually missing.

createAccount checks required fields in a fixed order and reports the first missing one; when testing AC-4, drop one field at a time. Required: name, email, password, firstname, lastname, address1, country, zipcode, state, city, mobile_number (all verified to give 400 'Bad request, <field> parameter is missing in POST request.' and no account). title, birth_*, company, address2 are optional (verified 201).

Wrong-method probes outside the contract answer differently: POST /updateAccount, POST /deleteAccount and GET /createAccount return a real HTTP 405 with {"detail": "Method \"POST\" not allowed."}. The contract only fixes DELETE /verifyLogin (body 405, HTTP 200) — met. Do not generalise.
Cleanup: D1 and D2 probes create extra accounts (upper-case and invalid e-mail) — they can and should be deleted with deleteAccount using that exact address.
verifyLogin with the e-mail in a different letter case answers 404 'User not found!' — this is NOT the AC-3 finding (AC-3 is about registration uniqueness); do not conflate.

UI: header text is 'Logged in as <name>' in the nav bar; login form fields use data-qa attributes (login-email, login-password, login-button). Wrong password error text: 'Your email or password is incorrect!'. Ads/consent overlays may appear; block ad domains.
AE_USER_PASSWORD contains special characters (e.g. '!', '#'); it must be URL-encoded in form bodies (Playwright form: {} does this).
expectations: AC-1 PASS: createAccount with all required fields -> responseCode 201 'User created!'.
AC-2 PASS: same e-mail again -> responseCode 400 'Email already exists!'.
AC-4 PASS: each required field missing -> responseCode 400 'Bad request, <field> parameter is missing in POST request.' and getUserDetailByEmail -> 404.
AC-6 PASS: 200 'User exists!'; wrong pw / unknown -> 404 'User not found!'; missing email or password -> 400 exact message; DELETE -> 405 'This request method is not supported.' (all HTTP 200).

AC-7 FAIL (D3) for mobile_number; the rest of AC-7 holds: other listed fields present with registration values, no password field, unknown e-mail -> 404 'Account not found with this email, try another email!'.
AC-8 PASS: PUT with email+password+city/company -> 200 'User updated!', only those fields change; wrong password -> 404 'Account not found!', nothing changes.
AC-9 PASS: DELETE (form body) -> 200 'Account deleted!'; then verifyLogin 404 'User not found!' and getUserDetailByEmail 404; wrong password -> 404 'Account not found!' and account still verifies.
AC-10 PASS: UI login with API-created account -> redirected to /, nav shows 'Logged in as <name>'; after updateAccount name='QA Author Renamed' the header shows 'Logged in as QA Author Renamed'.
AC-11 PASS: wrong password -> stays on /login, 'Your email or password is incorrect!'.
AC-12 PASS: after API deleteAccount, UI login -> same message.
